content.comment_body: Good morning, I would like to know if it's possible to create a web application for reporting from my [product_name] PLC [version_no]. Is this feasible? Sorry if my English isn't perfect.
No. If you send data from [product_name] to [product_name] first, then from [product_name] to the web. [product_name] has built-in web capabilities.
And if web isn't possible, is it possible to generate a personalized report?
Hi, are you looking for something like this: [url]? Then search for [product_name] Monitor. This is the only page I know. Hope this helps.
Hi, as far as I know, you need [version_no] for web access; for [product_name], you can only monitor variables using the [product_name] app on Android.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsure about how to create web-based or personalized reports with [company_name] PLCs, specifically referencing [product_name] and related hardware. There is confusion about built-in web capabilities and available alternatives for report generation. The conversation reveals a lack of clarity regarding which products support web connectivity and reporting features, leading to uncertainty over product selection and available functionalities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to generate web-based or personalized reports directly from their [company_name] PLC ([product_name] [version_no]) and are seeking clarity on whether this functionality is supported.
